AdjustWindowRectEx@WIN32API.INC.desc: Calculates the window rectangle size needed for a desired client rectangle, given window style, menu flag and extended style. The RECT is updated in place.

MessageBoxEx@WIN32API.INC.desc: Displays a message box like MessageBox, with an extra language identifier for the button text. Returns the ID of the button the user clicked.

MessageBeep@WIN32API.INC.desc: Plays a system waveform sound identified by the type (e.g. MB_ICONERROR, MB_OK). Returns nonzero on success.

ShowCursor@WIN32API.INC.desc: Increments or decrements the cursor display counter; the cursor is shown when the counter is 0 or more. Returns the new counter value.

GetCursorPos@WIN32API.INC.desc: Retrieves the position of the mouse cursor in screen coordinates into a POINT structure.

ClipCursor@WIN32API.INC.desc: Confines the cursor to a rectangle on the screen; pass NULL to free the cursor to move anywhere.

GetClipCursor@WIN32API.INC.desc: Retrieves the screen coordinates of the rectangle the cursor is confined to.

CreateCaret@WIN32API.INC.desc: Creates a new shape for the system caret and assigns ownership to the specified window; the shape can be a bitmap or a solid/gray block.

GetCaretBlinkTime@WIN32API.INC.desc: Returns the caret blink time in milliseconds (time between inverting the caret pixels).

SetCaretBlinkTime@WIN32API.INC.desc: Sets the caret blink time to the specified number of milliseconds.

DestroyCaret@WIN32API.INC.desc: Destroys the caret's current shape, frees it from the window and removes it from the screen.

HideCaret@WIN32API.INC.desc: Removes the caret from the screen without destroying its shape. Hiding is cumulative; ShowCaret must be called the same number of times.

ShowCaret@WIN32API.INC.desc: Makes the caret visible at its current position after it was created or hidden.

SetCaretPos@WIN32API.INC.desc: Moves the caret to the specified client coordinates of the window that owns it.

GetCaretPos@WIN32API.INC.desc: Copies the caret's position, in client coordinates, into a POINT structure.

ClientToScreen_WIN32API@WIN32API.INC.desc: Converts the client-area coordinates of a POINT for the given window to screen coordinates.

ScreenToClient@WIN32API.INC.desc: Converts the screen coordinates of a POINT to client-area coordinates of the given window.

MapWindowPoints@WIN32API.INC.desc: Converts an array of points from the coordinate space of one window to another (or the screen). Returns the horizontal/vertical offsets in low/high words.

WindowFromPoint@WIN32API.INC.desc: Returns a handle to the window that contains the specified screen point.

ChildWindowFromPoint@WIN32API.INC.desc: Returns the child window of a parent that contains a point given in the parent's client coordinates, or the parent itself if none.

SetSysColors@WIN32API.INC.desc: Sets the colors of one or more display elements (COLOR_* indices) and notifies all top-level windows with WM_SYSCOLORCHANGE.

DrawFocusRect@WIN32API.INC.desc: Draws a rectangle in the style used to indicate focus, using XOR so calling it again removes it.

FillRect@WIN32API.INC.desc: Fills a rectangle with the specified brush, including the left and top borders but excluding the right and bottom.

FrameRect@WIN32API.INC.desc: Draws a one-unit-wide border around a rectangle using the specified brush.

InvertRect@WIN32API.INC.desc: Inverts the colors of a rectangle on a device context using a logical NOT operation.

SetRectEmpty@WIN32API.INC.desc: Sets all coordinates of a RECT to zero, creating an empty rectangle.

CopyRect@WIN32API.INC.desc: Copies the coordinates of one RECT structure to another.

InflateRect@WIN32API.INC.desc: Increases or decreases the width and height of a rectangle by dx and dy on each side (negative values shrink it).

IntersectRect@WIN32API.INC.desc: Calculates the intersection of two rectangles into a destination RECT. Returns zero if they do not intersect.

UnionRect@WIN32API.INC.desc: Creates the smallest rectangle that contains both source rectangles.

SubtractRect@WIN32API.INC.desc: Determines the rectangle formed by subtracting one rectangle from another; works only when the result is a rectangle.

OffsetRect@WIN32API.INC.desc: Moves a rectangle by the specified horizontal and vertical amounts.

IsRectEmpty@WIN32API.INC.desc: Returns nonzero if the rectangle is empty (zero or negative width or height).

EqualRect@WIN32API.INC.desc: Returns nonzero if two rectangles have identical coordinates.

PtInRect@WIN32API.INC.desc: Returns nonzero if the point lies within the rectangle (right and bottom edges excluded).

GetWindowWord@WIN32API.INC.desc: Retrieves a 16-bit value at the given offset in the window's extra memory. Obsolete for most uses; use GetWindowLong.

SetWindowWord@WIN32API.INC.desc: Sets a 16-bit value at the given offset in the window's extra memory. Obsolete for most uses; use SetWindowLong.

GetClassWord@WIN32API.INC.desc: Retrieves a 16-bit value at the given offset in the window class extra memory, or GCW_ATOM. Mostly obsolete; use GetClassLong.

SetClassWord@WIN32API.INC.desc: Sets a 16-bit value at the given offset in the window class extra memory. Mostly obsolete; use SetClassLong.

GetClassLong@WIN32API.INC.desc: Retrieves a 32-bit value from the window class associated with a window, e.g. GCL_HICON or GCL_STYLE.

GetTopWindow@WIN32API.INC.desc: Returns the child window at the top of the Z order among the children of the specified window.

GetNextWindow@WIN32API.INC.desc: Returns a window related to the specified window by Z order or ownership (GW_CHILD, GW_HWNDNEXT, GW_OWNER, etc.).

GetWindowThreadProcessId@WIN32API.INC.desc: Returns the ID of the thread that created a window and optionally stores the owning process ID.

GetLastActivePopup@WIN32API.INC.desc: Returns the most recently active pop-up window owned by the specified window.

GetWindow@WIN32API.INC.desc: Returns a window related to the specified window by Z order or ownership (GW_CHILD, GW_HWNDNEXT, GW_OWNER, etc.).

UnhookWindowsHookEx@WIN32API.INC.desc: Removes a hook procedure installed by SetWindowsHookEx. Returns nonzero on success.

CallNextHookEx@WIN32API.INC.desc: Passes hook information to the next hook procedure in the current hook chain; returns that procedure's result.

LoadBitmap@WIN32API.INC.desc: Loads a bitmap resource from a module. Superseded by LoadImage.

CreateCursor@WIN32API.INC.desc: Creates a monochrome cursor of given size and hotspot from AND and XOR bit masks. Returns the cursor handle.

DestroyCursor@WIN32API.INC.desc: Destroys a cursor created with CreateCursor or similar and frees its memory. Do not use on shared cursors.

CopyCursor@WIN32API.INC.desc: Copies the specified cursor and returns a handle to the copy.

LoadIcon@WIN32API.INC.desc: Loads an icon resource from a module, or a predefined system icon when hInstance is NULL. Superseded by LoadImage.

CreateIcon@WIN32API.INC.desc: Creates an icon of given size and color format from AND and XOR bit arrays. Returns the icon handle.

LookupIconIdFromDirectory@WIN32API.INC.desc: Searches icon or cursor directory resource data for the image that best fits the current display; returns its resource ID.

CreateIconFromResource@WIN32API.INC.desc: Creates an icon or cursor from resource bits describing the image. Returns the icon or cursor handle.

CreateIconIndirect@WIN32API.INC.desc: Creates an icon or cursor from an ICONINFO structure (mask and color bitmaps, hotspot).

CopyIcon@WIN32API.INC.desc: Copies the specified icon from another module to the current module and returns a handle to the copy.

GetIconInfo@WIN32API.INC.desc: Retrieves information about an icon or cursor into an ICONINFO structure; the caller must delete the returned bitmaps.

IsDialogMessage@WIN32API.INC.desc: Determines whether a message is meant for the given dialog box and processes it (keyboard navigation) if so. Returns nonzero if processed.

MapDialogRect@WIN32API.INC.desc: Converts dialog box units in a RECT to screen units (pixels) for the specified dialog box.

DlgDirList@WIN32API.INC.desc: Fills a list box in a dialog with names of files, directories and drives matching a path or file name pattern.

DlgDirSelectEx@WIN32API.INC.desc: Retrieves the current selection from a list box filled by DlgDirList; returns nonzero if it is a drive or directory.

DlgDirListComboBox@WIN32API.INC.desc: Fills a combo box in a dialog with names of files, directories and drives matching a path or file name pattern.

DlgDirSelectComboBoxEx@WIN32API.INC.desc: Retrieves the current selection from a combo box filled by DlgDirListComboBox; returns nonzero if it is a drive or directory.

DefFrameProc@WIN32API.INC.desc: Provides default processing for window messages not handled by an MDI frame window procedure.

TranslateMDISysAccel@WIN32API.INC.desc: Processes accelerator keystrokes for window menu commands of MDI child windows. Returns nonzero if the message was translated.

ArrangeIconicWindows@WIN32API.INC.desc: Arranges all minimized (iconic) child windows of a parent window. Returns the height of one row of icons.

CreateMDIWindow@WIN32API.INC.desc: Creates a multiple-document interface (MDI) child window. Returns the handle of the new window.

WinHelp@WIN32API.INC.desc: Starts Windows Help (WinHelp.exe) and passes a help command. Obsolete; WinHelp is not supported on current Windows, use HTML Help.

DdeSetQualityOfService@WIN32API.INC.desc: Specifies the security quality of service a DDE client wants for future DDE conversations with servers.

ImpersonateDdeClientWindow@WIN32API.INC.desc: Enables a DDE server to impersonate the security context of a DDE client application.

PackDDElParam@WIN32API.INC.desc: Packs DDE lParam values into a handle for posting a DDE message; the result must be freed with FreeDDElParam.

UnpackDDElParam@WIN32API.INC.desc: Unpacks a DDE lParam value received from a posted DDE message into its low and high components.

FreeDDElParam@WIN32API.INC.desc: Frees the memory associated with a DDE lParam created by PackDDElParam.

ReuseDDElParam@WIN32API.INC.desc: Allows a received DDE lParam to be reused in a posted DDE response message, repacking it as needed.

DdeUninitialize@WIN32API.INC.desc: Frees all DDEML resources used by an application and terminates its conversations.

DdeConnectList@WIN32API.INC.desc: Establishes conversations with all servers that support the specified service and topic; returns a conversation list handle.

DdeQueryNextServer@WIN32API.INC.desc: Returns the next conversation handle in a conversation list created by DdeConnectList.

DdeDisconnectList@WIN32API.INC.desc: Destroys a conversation list and terminates all conversations associated with it.

DdeConnect@WIN32API.INC.desc: Establishes a DDE conversation with a server that supports the specified service and topic. Returns a conversation handle.

DdeDisconnect@WIN32API.INC.desc: Terminates a DDE conversation and invalidates its conversation handle.

DdeReconnect@WIN32API.INC.desc: Re-establishes a DDE conversation with a service that has terminated it.

DdeQueryConvInfo@WIN32API.INC.desc: Retrieves information about a DDE transaction and its conversation into a CONVINFO structure.

DdeSetUserHandle@WIN32API.INC.desc: Associates an application-defined value with a conversation handle or transaction ID.

DdeAbandonTransaction@WIN32API.INC.desc: Abandons the specified asynchronous transaction and releases its resources.

DdePostAdvise@WIN32API.INC.desc: Causes a DDE server to send an XTYP_ADVREQ transaction to its callback for each client with an active advise loop on the topic and item.

DdeEnableCallback@WIN32API.INC.desc: Enables or disables transactions for a specific conversation or all conversations of the calling application.

DdeImpersonateClient@WIN32API.INC.desc: Impersonates a DDE client application in a DDE client conversation.

DdeNameService@WIN32API.INC.desc: Registers or unregisters the service names a DDE server supports, and can turn service name filtering on or off.

DdeClientTransaction@WIN32API.INC.desc: Begins a DDE data transaction between a client and server (request, poke, execute, advise). Synchronous or asynchronous.

DdeCreateDataHandle@WIN32API.INC.desc: Creates a DDE object and fills it with data from a buffer; returns a data handle for passing in transactions.

DdeAddData@WIN32API.INC.desc: Adds data to a DDE object, starting at the given offset; the object is enlarged if needed.

DdeGetData@WIN32API.INC.desc: Copies data from a DDE object to a local buffer. Returns the number of bytes copied (or the object size if buffer is NULL).

DdeAccessData@WIN32API.INC.desc: Provides access to the data in a DDE object; returns a pointer to the first byte and its size.

DdeUnaccessData@WIN32API.INC.desc: Unaccesses a DDE object previously accessed with DdeAccessData.

DdeFreeDataHandle@WIN32API.INC.desc: Frees a DDE object and deletes the data handle associated with it.

DdeGetLastError@WIN32API.INC.desc: Retrieves the most recent error code set by a DDEML function and resets it.

DdeCreateStringHandle@WIN32API.INC.desc: Creates a DDE string handle for the specified string, used by DDEML functions. Free with DdeFreeStringHandle.

DdeQueryString@WIN32API.INC.desc: Copies the text associated with a DDE string handle into a buffer; returns the string length.

DdeFreeStringHandle@WIN32API.INC.desc: Frees a DDE string handle created by DdeCreateStringHandle.

DdeKeepStringHandle@WIN32API.INC.desc: Increments the usage count of a DDE string handle so it remains valid after the callback returns.

DdeCmpStringHandles@WIN32API.INC.desc: Compares the values of two DDE string handles (case-insensitive). Returns -1, 0 or 1.

mixerGetNumDevs@WIN32API.INC.desc: Returns the number of mixer devices present in the system.

mixerGetDevCaps@WIN32API.INC.desc: Queries a mixer device for its capabilities into a MIXERCAPS structure.

mixerOpen@WIN32API.INC.desc: Opens a mixer device and returns a handle; can register a callback window or function for change notifications.

mixerMessage@WIN32API.INC.desc: Sends a custom mixer driver message directly to a mixer driver.

mixerGetLineInfo@WIN32API.INC.desc: Retrieves information about a specific line of a mixer device into a MIXERLINE structure.

mixerGetID@WIN32API.INC.desc: Retrieves the device identifier for a mixer device associated with a device handle.

mixerGetLineControls@WIN32API.INC.desc: Retrieves one or more controls associated with an audio line into a MIXERLINECONTROLS structure.

mixerGetControlDetails@WIN32API.INC.desc: Retrieves details about a single control associated with an audio line (e.g. current volume value).

mixerSetControlDetails@WIN32API.INC.desc: Sets properties of a single control associated with an audio line (e.g. volume or mute).

joyGetPos@WIN32API.INC.desc: Queries a joystick for its position and button status into a JOYINFO structure. Superseded by joyGetPosEx.

joyGetPosEx@WIN32API.INC.desc: Queries a joystick for its position and button status into a JOYINFOEX structure (up to six axes, 32 buttons, POV).

midiStreamOpen@WIN32API.INC.desc: Opens a MIDI stream for output; the stream starts paused. Returns MMSYSERR_NOERROR on success.

midiStreamProperty@WIN32API.INC.desc: Sets or retrieves properties of a MIDI stream, such as time division or tempo.

midiStreamPosition@WIN32API.INC.desc: Retrieves the current position in a MIDI stream into an MMTIME structure.

midiStreamOut@WIN32API.INC.desc: Plays or queues a buffer of MIDI data (prepared MIDIHDR) on a MIDI output stream.

midiStreamPause@WIN32API.INC.desc: Pauses playback of a MIDI stream.

midiStreamStop@WIN32API.INC.desc: Turns off all notes on all MIDI channels and stops the stream, returning queued buffers.

midiConnect@WIN32API.INC.desc: Connects a MIDI input device to a MIDI thru or output device, or a thru device to an output device.

midiDisconnect@WIN32API.INC.desc: Disconnects a MIDI input device from a MIDI thru or output device.

CloseDriver@WIN32API.INC.desc: Closes an installable driver opened with OpenDriver.

OpenDriver@WIN32API.INC.desc: Opens an instance of an installable driver and initializes it. Returns a driver handle.

SendDriverMessage@WIN32API.INC.desc: Sends a message to the specified installable driver and returns the driver's result.

DrvGetModuleHandle@WIN32API.INC.desc: Retrieves the module instance handle of an installable driver. Obsolete; use GetDriverModuleHandle.

GetDriverModuleHandle@WIN32API.INC.desc: Retrieves the instance handle of the module that contains the specified installable driver.

DefDriverProc@WIN32API.INC.desc: Provides default processing for messages not handled by an installable driver.

mmsystemGetVersion@WIN32API.INC.desc: Returns the version number of the Windows multimedia system (WinMM).

OutputDebugStr@WIN32API.INC.desc: Not in the Microsoft documentation: winmm export that sends a string to the debugger, like kernel32 OutputDebugString (16-bit compatibility).

sndPlaySound@WIN32API.INC.desc: Plays a waveform sound given by a file name or system event name. Superseded by PlaySound.

PlaySound@WIN32API.INC.desc: Plays a sound specified by file name, resource or system event alias (SND_FILENAME, SND_ASYNC, SND_LOOP, etc.).

waveOutGetNumDevs@WIN32API.INC.desc: Returns the number of waveform-audio output devices present in the system.

waveOutGetDevCaps@WIN32API.INC.desc: Retrieves the capabilities of a waveform-audio output device into a WAVEOUTCAPS structure.

waveOutGetVolume@WIN32API.INC.desc: Retrieves the current volume of a waveform-audio output device (low word left, high word right).

waveOutSetVolume@WIN32API.INC.desc: Sets the volume of a waveform-audio output device (low word left, high word right, 0-0xFFFF).

waveOutGetErrorText@WIN32API.INC.desc: Retrieves a text description of an MMSYSERR/WAVERR error code into a buffer.

waveOutOpen@WIN32API.INC.desc: Opens a waveform-audio output device for playback in a given WAVEFORMATEX format; returns a device handle.

waveOutClose@WIN32API.INC.desc: Closes a waveform-audio output device. Fails if buffers are still queued; call waveOutReset first.

waveOutPrepareHeader@WIN32API.INC.desc: Prepares a WAVEHDR data block for waveform-audio output; required before waveOutWrite.

waveOutUnprepareHeader@WIN32API.INC.desc: Cleans up the preparation done by waveOutPrepareHeader after the device has finished with the block.

waveOutWrite@WIN32API.INC.desc: Sends a prepared data block (WAVEHDR) to a waveform-audio output device for playback.

waveOutPause@WIN32API.INC.desc: Pauses playback on a waveform-audio output device, saving the current position.

waveOutRestart@WIN32API.INC.desc: Resumes playback on a paused waveform-audio output device.

waveOutReset@WIN32API.INC.desc: Stops playback on a waveform-audio output device, resets position to zero and marks pending buffers done.

waveOutBreakLoop@WIN32API.INC.desc: Breaks a loop on a waveform-audio output device and allows playback to continue with the next block.

waveOutGetPosition@WIN32API.INC.desc: Retrieves the current playback position of a waveform-audio output device into an MMTIME structure.

waveOutGetPitch@WIN32API.INC.desc: Retrieves the current pitch setting of a waveform-audio output device (fixed-point multiplier).

waveOutSetPitch@WIN32API.INC.desc: Sets the pitch for a waveform-audio output device, if supported (fixed-point multiplier).

waveOutGetPlaybackRate@WIN32API.INC.desc: Retrieves the current playback rate of a waveform-audio output device (fixed-point multiplier).

waveOutSetPlaybackRate@WIN32API.INC.desc: Sets the playback rate of a waveform-audio output device, if supported (fixed-point multiplier).

waveOutGetID@WIN32API.INC.desc: Retrieves the device identifier for the given waveform-audio output device handle.

waveOutMessage@WIN32API.INC.desc: Sends a custom message to a waveform-audio output device driver.

waveInGetNumDevs@WIN32API.INC.desc: Returns the number of waveform-audio input devices present in the system.

waveInGetDevCaps@WIN32API.INC.desc: Retrieves the capabilities of a waveform-audio input device into a WAVEINCAPS structure.

waveInGetErrorText@WIN32API.INC.desc: Retrieves a text description of an MMSYSERR/WAVERR error code into a buffer.

waveInOpen@WIN32API.INC.desc: Opens a waveform-audio input device for recording in a given WAVEFORMATEX format; returns a device handle.

waveInClose@WIN32API.INC.desc: Closes a waveform-audio input device. Fails if buffers are still queued; call waveInReset first.

waveInPrepareHeader@WIN32API.INC.desc: Prepares a WAVEHDR buffer for waveform-audio input; required before waveInAddBuffer.

waveInUnprepareHeader@WIN32API.INC.desc: Cleans up the preparation done by waveInPrepareHeader after the device has finished with the buffer.

waveInAddBuffer@WIN32API.INC.desc: Sends a prepared input buffer to a waveform-audio input device; the application is notified when it is filled.

waveInStart@WIN32API.INC.desc: Starts input (recording) on a waveform-audio input device.

waveInStop@WIN32API.INC.desc: Stops input on a waveform-audio input device; the current buffer is marked done and returned.

waveInReset@WIN32API.INC.desc: Stops input on a waveform-audio input device, resets position to zero and returns all pending buffers.

waveInGetPosition@WIN32API.INC.desc: Retrieves the current input position of a waveform-audio input device into an MMTIME structure.

waveInGetID@WIN32API.INC.desc: Retrieves the device identifier for the given waveform-audio input device handle.

waveInMessage@WIN32API.INC.desc: Sends a custom message to a waveform-audio input device driver.

midiOutGetDevCaps@WIN32API.INC.desc: Queries a MIDI output device for its capabilities into a MIDIOUTCAPS structure.

midiOutGetVolume@WIN32API.INC.desc: Retrieves the current volume of a MIDI output device (low word left, high word right).

midiOutSetVolume@WIN32API.INC.desc: Sets the volume of a MIDI output device (low word left, high word right, 0-0xFFFF).

midiOutGetErrorText@WIN32API.INC.desc: Retrieves a text description of a MIDI/MMSYSERR error code into a buffer.

midiOutOpen@WIN32API.INC.desc: Opens a MIDI output device for playback; returns a device handle and can register a callback.

midiOutClose@WIN32API.INC.desc: Closes a MIDI output device. Fails if buffers are still pending; call midiOutReset first.

midiOutPrepareHeader@WIN32API.INC.desc: Prepares a MIDIHDR system-exclusive or stream buffer for output.

midiOutUnprepareHeader@WIN32API.INC.desc: Cleans up the preparation done by midiOutPrepareHeader after the device has finished with the buffer.

midiOutShortMsg@WIN32API.INC.desc: Sends a short MIDI message (status and up to two data bytes packed in a DWORD) to a MIDI output device.

midiOutLongMsg@WIN32API.INC.desc: Sends a system-exclusive MIDI message in a prepared MIDIHDR buffer to a MIDI output device.

midiOutReset@WIN32API.INC.desc: Turns off all notes on all MIDI channels of an output device and returns pending output buffers.

midiOutCachePatches@WIN32API.INC.desc: Requests an internal MIDI synthesizer to preload and cache specified patches.

midiOutCacheDrumPatches@WIN32API.INC.desc: Requests an internal MIDI synthesizer to preload and cache specified key-based percussion patches.

midiOutGetID@WIN32API.INC.desc: Retrieves the device identifier for the given MIDI output device handle.

midiOutMessage@WIN32API.INC.desc: Sends a custom message to a MIDI output device driver.

midiInGetNumDevs@WIN32API.INC.desc: Returns the number of MIDI input devices in the system.

midiInGetDevCaps@WIN32API.INC.desc: Queries a MIDI input device for its capabilities into a MIDIINCAPS structure.

midiInGetErrorText@WIN32API.INC.desc: Retrieves a text description of a MIDI/MMSYSERR error code into a buffer.

midiInOpen@WIN32API.INC.desc: Opens a MIDI input device; returns a device handle and registers a callback for incoming messages.

midiInClose@WIN32API.INC.desc: Closes a MIDI input device. Fails if buffers are still pending; call midiInReset first.

midiInPrepareHeader@WIN32API.INC.desc: Prepares a MIDIHDR buffer for MIDI input.

midiInUnprepareHeader@WIN32API.INC.desc: Cleans up the preparation done by midiInPrepareHeader.

midiInAddBuffer@WIN32API.INC.desc: Sends a prepared input buffer to an open MIDI input device for system-exclusive messages.

midiInStart@WIN32API.INC.desc: Starts MIDI input on the specified device; timestamps are reset to zero.

midiInStop@WIN32API.INC.desc: Stops MIDI input on the specified device.

midiInReset@WIN32API.INC.desc: Stops input on a MIDI input device and returns all pending input buffers marked done.

midiInGetID@WIN32API.INC.desc: Retrieves the device identifier for the given MIDI input device handle.

midiInMessage@WIN32API.INC.desc: Sends a custom message to a MIDI input device driver.

auxGetNumDevs@WIN32API.INC.desc: Returns the number of auxiliary audio output devices present in the system.
